title: VanillaBase
description: A standard mod pack for survival/hardcore. Minimal load on your device!
body:
###⚡Vanilla Base(1.21.10)

A lightweight and stable modpack for Minecraft 1.21.10 that improves performance, interface, and visuals — without changing the vanilla gameplay experience.

This pack is designed for players who want higher FPS, smoother animations, and better usability while keeping the original game balance intact.

THE VERY BASE FOR REGULAR SURVIVAL OR SERVER PLAYING WHEN YOU NEED TO QUICKLY MAKE A VERSION

**🚀 Main Features**

> Performance optimization — higher FPS and improved stability
> 
> Improved map / minimap for easier navigation
> 
> 3D skin support
> 
> Cleaner and more user-friendly interfaces
> 
> Fixed and smoother animations
> 
> Faster world loading

**🎮 Pure Vanilla Experience**

> No new items or gameplay mechanics
> 
> Game balance remains unchanged
> 
> Suitable for singleplayer and servers
> 
> Great choice for low-end and mid-range PCs

**💻 Requirements**

> Version: Minecraft 1.21.10
> 
> Recommended RAM: 2–4 GB
> 
> Server support: Yes
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vanilla+ Performance Pack (1.21.10) is a lightweight and stable modpack for Minecraft 1.21.10 designed to improve performance, visuals, and overall usability without changing the core vanilla experience. This pack focuses on optimization and quality-of-life improvements, giving you higher FPS, smoother animations, faster world loading, and a cleaner interface while keeping the original game balance completely intact.

  It includes performance-enhancing mods, an improved map/minimap for better navigation, 3D skin support, refined UI elements, and animation fixes to make gameplay feel smoother and more modern. No new items, mechanics, or progression changes are added — everything remains true to vanilla Minecraft.

This modpack is suitable for both singleplayer and servers and works especially well on low-end and mid-range PCs, requiring only 2–4 GB of RAM. It’s the perfect choice for players who want a cleaner, faster, and more polished Minecraft 1.21.10 experience without altering the original gameplay.
